position: `/api/export` serialises the whole annotations table in one unbounded response (L1). The comparator never issues it. Equivalence is proved over a bounded, recorded range, slice by slice, against a manifest digest -- and a range that cannot be bounded costs recorded coverage instead of being silently skipped.

equivalence_cases.name: bounded-range-matches-the-paged-read
equivalence_cases.why: The property the boundaries document owes an operator: page exhaustion over a recorded (since_id, max_id) pair is byte-equivalent to the export of that range.

equivalence_cases.name: an-empty-bounded-range-is-still-a-proof
equivalence_cases.why: Nothing in the range, agreed by both sides, is evidence of agreement rather than an absence of evidence.

equivalence_cases.name: an-unbounded-request-is-refused-not-audited
equivalence_cases.why: An auditor that needs the resources of the defect it is auditing is a second outage.

equivalence_cases.name: a-range-past-the-cap-is-split-never-widened
equivalence_cases.why: The cap is a bound on one proof, not a budget to be raised when a proof is inconvenient.

equivalence_cases.name: two-sides-returned-different-row-counts
equivalence_cases.why: A row the export drops between pages is exactly the loss this comparison exists to catch.

equivalence_cases.name: a-manifest-that-lies-about-its-row-count
equivalence_cases.why: The manifest is part of the evidence; a manifest that disagrees with its own payload is a finding, not a rounding.

equivalence_cases.name: same-rows-different-order
equivalence_cases.why: An export is an ordered range; the slice digest is order-dependent on purpose.

equivalence_cases.name: same-row-count-different-content
equivalence_cases.why: Counting rows is not comparing them.

classify_cases.name: a-refused-unbounded-export-costs-coverage-and-blocks-nothing

export.reason: the range could not be bounded

classify_cases.why: A read the comparator may not issue is not a defect in either store. It is coverage loss, and coverage loss is reported.

export.reason: same row count, different ordered content digest

classify_cases.name: an-export-verdict-this-build-cannot-read
classify_cases.why: A verdict this build cannot interpret must never be stepped over by a gate.

coverage_cases.name: a-refused-export-is-named-in-the-coverage-block
coverage_cases.why: A refused range leaves the eligible denominator as well as the numerator, so refusing to read it cannot inflate the ratio. Sampling does not: a sampled-away page was eligible and the ratio should say so.

bounds.why: Slices are bounded so neither the comparator nor the legacy service ever materialises a whole dump on either side.
